settings.heading: A Golf Media Brand, From The Ground Up
settings.text: Behind The Greens covers the side of golf almost nobody films — the maintenance crews, the agronomy, and the course culture behind every playable fairway. That perspective is unique in golf media, and it has built a loyal, highly engaged audience of golfers and industry insiders who trust what we show them.

settings.heading: Behind The Greens: Course Features
settings.text: Behind The Greens travels to your property to produce a documentary-style long-form episode telling the story of your course and the people who maintain it. We film alongside your crew, show what actually goes into keeping the course playable, and sit down with your superintendent to talk operation, philosophy, and history. This is a premium editorial feature — not videography for hire.
settings.pricing_note: Every Course Feature is scoped to the property. Reach out and we'll walk through what's possible.
